Class SwingSizingUtils

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.swing.SwingSizingUtils
public final class SwingSizingUtils extends Object
Scale-aware helpers for deriving Swing sizes from rendered content.

    • availableDesktopWidth

      public static int availableDesktopWidth(JInternalFrame frame)
      Return usable width to the right of an internal frame within its virtual desktop column.

      MDI implements virtual columns by offsetting frame X coordinates by whole desktop widths. Consequently, an off-screen frame can have a very large positive or negative X coordinate. Reducing that coordinate modulo the desktop width recovers its column-local position.
